name: hitbox
title: world.hitbox
lead: Makes an invisible box a player can click; `solid` also makes it a wall. `depth` is the width unless given. 1.19.4 and later.
signature: world.hitbox(opts: { at: Vec3, width: number ?, height: number ?, depth: number ?, solid: boolean ?, on_click: ((player: Player, button: "left" | "right") -> ())?, }) → Hitbox

params.name: opts
params.type: { at: Vec3 , width: number ?, height: number ?, depth: number ?, solid: boolean ?, on_click: ((player: Player , button: "left" | "right" ) -> ())?, }

usedIn.quote: local h = world.hitbox{ at = vec3(...), width = 1, height = 1, on_click = function(player, button) end }
`world.hitbox{ ..., solid = true }` is also a **wall**. A player cannot walk
